thread:
ray (incident-bot): ALERT: spike in 5xx and timeouts for /v1/generate across prod us-west-2 — errors rising from ~0.2% to 6.8% in last 3m. 429s and 503s correlated. Paging @ryan (oncall) :rotating_light:
ryan (oncall): on it, pulling up dashboards and recent deploys. any deploys in last 15m?
sanjay: I pushed a quota/ratelimit change to the edge-rules 12m ago (config id: edge-q-2026-03) to tighten per-tenant token rates. didn’t expect a global effect but it touched default policy.
emma: seeing the same. traces show spikes at the API gateway -> auth -> inference-proxy chain. 429s convert to retries and cause backend saturation -> 503s.
lisa: customer postmortem note: 4 enterprise tenants showing sustained failures (20-40% requests failing). smaller clients see short spikes.
ryan (oncall): good context. immediate plan: 1) revert the recent quota config, 2) enable permissive fallback at gateway to avoid hard 429s, 3) open fallback route to alternate region pool. anyone volunteer to do the config rollback?
sanjay: I can rollback edge-q-2026-03. doing `kubectl -n config apply -f edge-q-previous.yaml` now.
ray (incident-bot): ACTION: deployment rollback triggered by sanjay at 3135792501.
sanjay: rolled back. confirmed old policy restored.
emma: toggling gateway enforcement to permissive mode (ip and tenant bypass) for 10m. command: `curl -X POST https://ops-api/gateway/enforce -d '{"mode":"permissive"}'` — applied.
lisa: routing change: open routed traffic to us-east-1 read pool as overflow for inference-proxy. updating routing weight to 15% now.
ryan (oncall): monitoring latency and errors. initial metrics: errors drop from 6.8% -> 2.1% in 90s after rollback + permissive gate. 503s are still slightly elevated, likely due to retry storm queued at proxies.
emma: clearing retry queues on proxy nodes (command: `adminctl proxy drain --queue-threshold=100`) in progress.
sanjay: quick log snippet showing the problem pattern:
```
[2026-03-15T20:12:34Z] gateway=auth service=inference-proxy status=429 tenant=acct-123 tokens=0
[2026-03-15T20:12:35Z] inference-proxy status=503 reason=backend_unavailable queued=320
```
ryan (oncall): good. continuing to watch. @lisa can you notify support + add affected tenant list to the incident doc? include mitigation notes and ETA for full recovery.
lisa: notifying support now — will send template with impacted customers and recommended mitigation steps. ETA for full recovery estimate 15-30m, depending on backend drain. :white_check_mark:
ray (incident-bot): INCIDENT UPDATE: partial mitigation in place — rollback + permissive enforcement + routing overflow. Customer impact reduced but not resolved.
ryan (oncall): next steps: keep permissive for 20m, observe. if residual 5xx >1% we’ll scale dedicated inference-pool by +2 nodes and enable emergency fallback model (smaller quantized model) for high-retry tenants.
emma: scaling + enabling fallback in progress. `infractl scale inference-pool --name=dedicated-prod-us-west2 --delta=2`
sanjay: note to self: add a guard in deploy pipeline so edge default policy changes require an extra approval or staged rollout to prevent global flips.
lisa: support message posted to affected customers, status page updated: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/3135792468
ray (incident-bot): RESOLUTION: after 18m error rates back to baseline ~0.25%. marking incident as mitigated. please add RCA notes and follow-up tasks: staged rollout for quota changes, safe default policy, and better retry backoff at proxies. :memo:
ryan (oncall): thanks team. I’ll own the RCA draft and schedule a follow-up postmortem tomorrow. closing on-call shift in 30m but will stay on watch until metrics fully stable.
